purpose: Run and maintain the virtualization installation test harness.
notes: Use action_tests/run_env_test.sh for the selected target environment. Read its environment and privilege requirements, use isolated guests and keep fixture evidence distinct from real installation/guest-boot evidence.
purpose_zh: 运行和维护虚拟化安装脚本的自动化测试环境。
notes_zh: 按目标环境使用 action_tests/run_env_test.sh，先阅读权限及环境要求，在隔离客户机测试，并区分模拟数据、真实安装和客户机启动证据。
